```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```


```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
csv_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes" / "county_2020_fips_codes.csv"
centroids_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes" / "US_Counties_Centroids.csv"
```


```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_csv(
    csv_path, 
    encoding='latin-1', 
    delimiter="|", 
    dtype={'STATEFP': str, 'COUNTYFP': str, 'COUNTYNS': str}
)
```

```{python}
centroids_df = pd.read_csv(
    centroids_path,
    dtype={"FIPS_CD": str}
)
```

```{python}
centroids_df = centroids_df.rename(columns = {
    "FIPS_CD": "combined_state_county_code",
    "LONGITUDE": "county_longitude",
    "LATITUDE": "county_latitude"
})

centroids_df["combined_state_county_code"] = (centroids_df["combined_state_county_code"]).str.zfill(5)

centroids_df["county_centroid_longitude"] = pd.to_numeric(
    centroids_df["county_longitude"], errors="coerce"
)
centroids_df["county_centroid_latitude"] = pd.to_numeric(
    centroids_df["county_latitude"], errors="coerce"
)
```

```{python}
df_final = df_raw.rename(columns={
    "STATE": "state",
    "STATEFP": "state_fips_code",
    "COUNTYFP": "county_fips_code",
    "COUNTYNS": "county_ns_code",
    "COUNTYNAME": "county_name",
    "CLASSFP": "fips_class_code",
    "FUNCSTAT": "functional_status"
})
```

```{python}
df_final["combined_state_county_code"] = df_final["state_fips_code"] + df_final["county_fips_code"]
```

```{python}
df_final = df_final.merge(
    centroids_df[["combined_state_county_code", "county_centroid_longitude", "county_centroid_latitude"]],
    on="combined_state_county_code",
    how="left"
)
```

```{python}
df_final.describe(include=[object])
```

```{python}
centroid_missing = df_final[df_final[["county_centroid_longitude", "county_centroid_latitude"]].isna().any(axis = 1)]
centroid_missing
# Looks like these are all non-mainland counties so we should be good
```

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```


```{python}
df_final.to_sql(
    "us_counties",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
